focus: StockRoom and FloorFamily in GenStep_DungeonLayout.cs: runtime errors only (GenPlace.TryPlaceThing Direct onto ShelfSmall with a partially-merged stack, item destroy logic, ThingSetMaker params).
diffSource: since build 34 (2026-10-10T03:17:36Z), the last reviewed build, from the build log

findings.title: Non-stackable goods are always placed, even onto a full shelf
findings.detail: TryPlaceDirect sets num3 = 1 when the cell is at maxItemsInCell and the thing's stackLimit <= 1, so weapons and apparel spawn onto the first shelf tried regardless of capacity. Nothing errors, but the StockRoom summary ('whatever does not fit on a shelf is not spawned') only holds for stackable goods. If the cap matters, skip a shelf when shelves[k].GetItemCount(map) >= GetMaxItemsAllowedInCell(map) before calling TryPlaceThing.

findings.title: Split-off pieces of an over-limit stack are not forbidden
findings.detail: SplitAndSpawnOneStackOnCell spawns a SplitOff piece and returns false, then the loop spawns the remainder; TryPlaceThing's out param holds only the last resulting thing, so Forbid(put) misses the earlier pieces (and every piece spawned before a placement that then returns false). This only applies when ThingSetMaker returns stackCount > stackLimit. Passing a placedAction (thing, count) => thing.SetForbidden(true, false) to TryPlaceThing forbids every piece.

checked: GenPlace.TryPlaceThing Direct mode never logs on failure; a partly merged stack returns false and leaves t unspawned with a smaller stackCount (GenPlace.cs:33-127, 321-370)
the item destroy guard (!placed && !t.Destroyed && !t.Spawned) only destroys unspawned, live things; a fully absorbed t is already destroyed and returns placed=true
Forbid: SetForbidden(true, warnOnFail:false) does not log on things without the forbid comp; null put is guarded
ThingSetMakerParams (techLevel Undefined, totalMarketValueRange, countRange) match vanilla SymbolResolver_Stockpile for no faction (SymbolResolver_Stockpile.cs:42-60)
ThingSetMaker_Sum handles countRange/totalMarketValueRange per option without logging; the Empire conditional option is skipped when makingFaction is null

shelf cells skip edifices, items and door-adjacent cells, so the later door-clearing loop never destroys a shelf
